sources.title: June 2026: Premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts
sources.kind: monthly Project Gigabit contract management information
facts: The page publishes contract-level premises contracted and built for June 2026.
The release belongs to BDUK's monthly management-information collection.
limits: The figures are not current provider orderability checks.
Contract totals do not establish exact UPRN service.

sources.title: March 2026: Premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts
sources.kind: monthly Project Gigabit contract management information
facts: The page publishes contract-level premises contracted and built for March 2026.
The page is an administrative delivery snapshot.
limits: A built count is not evidence that every listed premises is connected.
Figures are not directly transferable to parcel truth.
sources.licence: Crown copyright; Open Government Licence v3.0 where stated

sources.title: January 2026: Premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts
sources.kind: monthly Project Gigabit contract management information
facts: The page publishes contract-level premises contracted and built for January 2026.
The release is part of BDUK's management-information series.
limits: The snapshot is historical relative to July 2026.
Contract records do not prove current orderability.

sources.publisher: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology
sources.title: Guidance on access agreements
sources.geo: United Kingdom local authorities, landowners and network operators
facts: The guidance promotes access to public-sector land and assets for digital deployment.
It encourages constructive engagement between authorities and network operators.
limits: Guidance does not grant a specific access right.
An access agreement is not evidence of a completed network build.
sources.licence: Crown copyright; Open Government Licence v3.0 where stated

sources.publisher: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology
sources.title: Digital and telecoms: resources for local authorities
facts: The page links access, street works and Project Gigabit resources for local authorities.
It includes guidance on public-sector land and digital infrastructure deployment.
limits: Linked guidance does not prove local build completion.
sources.licence: Crown copyright; Open Government Licence v3.0 where stated

sources.publisher: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology
sources.title: New build connectivity: information for developers
sources.geo: England building developers and network operators
facts: The guidance describes gigabit-ready infrastructure and connection requirements for new homes.
Requirements are performance-based and allow different network technologies.
limits: Building compliance does not prove a retail package is active.
Scope and exceptions depend on the building and regulations.
sources.licence: Crown copyright; Open Government Licence v3.0 where stated

sources.title: Street works permit schemes
facts: The guidance reflects rules applying from 10 April 2026.
It covers permit-scheme administration and related charges or penalties.
limits: Permit guidance does not confirm a telecoms deployment.
Application depends on the works and highway authority.
sources.licence: Crown copyright; Open Government Licence v3.0 where stated

sources.title: BDUK broadband delivery guidance
sources.geo: United Kingdom gigabit infrastructure suppliers and authorities
facts: The guidance covers delivery near protected land, heritage assets and Network Rail property.
It links standardised access and wayleave guidance.
limits: Guidance does not prove a route or wayleave has been secured.
Delivery advice is not parcel-level availability.
sources.licence: Crown copyright; Open Government Licence v3.0 where stated

sources.publisher: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology
sources.title: Statement of Strategic Priorities for telecommunications, the management of radio spectrum, and postal services
sources.geo: United Kingdom telecommunications, spectrum and postal regulation
facts: The statement was designated on 27 April 2026.
It sets strategic priorities including fixed and wireless digital infrastructure.
limits: Strategic priorities are policy directions rather than delivery evidence.
They do not establish service for a specific premises.
sources.licence: Crown copyright; Open Government Licence v3.0 where stated
